name: Hiraizumi Ruri
source: Joins in the earth route. Master of the lighting type guardian Kirara. Boy crazy, but her luck with men is horrible due to Egubado's attacks interfering with all of her dates. [spoiler]Has the reputation of being the only character with a straight sex scene in a otherwise yuri game.[/spoiler]
